state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors ask whether their tasks are hard enough to give generalizable easy-to-hard results: the largest difficulty gap they test is between 3rd grade and college level STEM questions, while concurrent work (Burns et al., 2023) has called for gaps as large as 3rd grade to 12th grade, so they see their results as relevant for future work that may operationalize easy and hard differently.
title: Open question: are the tested hardness gaps large enough to generalize easy-to-hard?
